body:
**This release fixes a security vulnerability ([GHSA-v887-64wg-qqc9](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/security/advisories/GHSA-v887-64wg-qqc9)): a specially crafted message could crash Mailpit's SMTP server. Updating is recommended.**

It also includes a large number of smaller fixes and hardening changes from a review of the codebase. Almost all of them are under the hood: tighter limits on memory and CPU use, more careful parsing of messages and headers, and better handling of edge cases. For most users nothing should look or behave differently.

### A few changes may need attention when upgrading:

- Flags and environment variables that have been deprecated for over two years have been removed. A relay config that still uses `recipient-allowlist` will now stop Mailpit from starting: rename it to `allowed-recipients`.
- Some settings are now checked at startup and refused if invalid, where they were previously ignored or treated as 0: relay and forward ports, `return-path`, `--max-age`, integer environment variables, and empty authentication credentials.
- The send API returns new responses: 400 for a From address that cannot be parsed, 413 for a message over the maximum message size, and 503 (with `Retry-After`) when too many messages are being sent at once.
- Messages are limited to 100 tags.

### Chore
- Reduce CPU cost of message ingestion ([#771](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/771))
- Recover from panics in SMTP sessions
- Use the SpamAssassin server's required score to decide what is spam
- Limit the HTML parsing of the embedded message view
- Refuse to render HTML over 10 MiB in the message view
- Limit how many bytes of messages are stored at once
- Treat a bare CR in headers as text, as Go and Postfix do
- Stop the storage background goroutines before re-initialising
- Limit the terms of a search and the memory a search holds
- Cache host names of SMTP clients for a short time
- Lower the size limit of proxied images and fonts to 10 MiB
- Limit the size of the messages a websocket client can send
- Remove deprecated flags and environment settings
- Validate relay and forward ports and return-path at startup
- Update Go dependencies
- Update node dependencies
- Update Github Actions dependencies

### Fix
- Make field searches case-insensitive for non-ASCII characters
- Show the current UTC offset in the timezone setting ([#773](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/773))
- Make dump paging and failure handling fail closed
- Make credential loading and matching fail closed
- Harden the HTML checker against slow and concurrent input
- Bound and clean up link checking
- Stop log messages injecting terminal control sequences
- Silence the logger once for the POP3 tests
- Correct POP3 TOP and dot-stuffing, and harden connection handling
- Make the database last-action time safe for concurrent use
- Limit the number of tags on a message to 100
- Bound the Prometheus tag series and harden the metrics server
- Harden the Rspamd integration
- Harden the snakeoil self-signed certificate generator
- Harden the SpamAssassin integration
- Reuse webhook connections to prevent dropped webhooks under load ([#772](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/772))
- Prevent SMTP crash on unparseable media type with RFC 2231 parameter ([GHSA-v887-64wg-qqc9](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/security/advisories/GHSA-v887-64wg-qqc9))
- Stop the version lookup blocking requests and fix its backoff
- Stop EXIF rotation copying large images and limit thumbnail decodes
- Limit the size of progressive JPEGs that are thumbnailed
- Remove List-Unsubscribe comments in a single pass and limit its length
- Locate message headers by position when rewriting them
- Use the text part for the snippet when the HTML has no text
- Keep text that is the same as a skipped element's name
- Trim truncated tags and stop PrepareSocket removing files
- Make --smtp-strict-rfc-headers cover all non-CRLF header line breaks
- Reduce the cost of HTML redirect stripping and text snippets
- Set the start time when the stats package loads
- Stream the message to Postmark without copying it
- Stop thumbnails for requests whose client has gone
- Reject messages with unreadable headers permanently
- Send only CRLF line breaks when relaying, and keep the stored body
- Remove whitespace before the colon of header names
- Handle more IDs than SQLite has placeholders for
- Tell the web UI about every message a search deleted
- Do not fail searches for sizes beyond what a database can compare
- Look up the client's host name without holding up other connections
- Time out TLS clients who never start the handshake
- Limit how much memory messages being received can use
- Make SMTP Shutdown wait for the open sessions
- Give relaying and forwarding time limits
- End the transaction when a MAIL command is refused
- Close the connections the proxy opens to fetch assets
- Allow sending messages through the API over a Unix socket
- Limit the cost of proxying a stylesheet
- Limit and cache the SpamAssassin checks of messages
- Make the Chaos settings and the HTML preview route safe for concurrent use
- Release a message to the addresses which were checked
- Rewrite the inline image links of a message in a single pass
- Limit the memory used by messages sent through the API
- Reject invalid integer environment variables instead of using 0
- Use the default sender when ingesting messages without a From address
- Reject --max-age values too large to calculate the prune cutoff
- Apply the return-path option to forwarded and auto-relayed messages
- Keep the quotes of an address in the sender and recipients which are sent
- Give the sendmail command and ingest time limits when sending
- Send the messages of the sendmail command with CR LF line breaks
- Reject line breaks in the From address of the send API
- Resolve proxied CSS assets after redirects ([#774](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/774))
- Preserve inline data URLs in proxied CSS ([#776](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/776))
- Encode screenshot proxy query parameters ([#775](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/775))
- Send PLAIN credentials when relaying or forwarding over implicit TLS
- Hold progressive JPEGs with skipped bytes to the progressive limit
- End the SMTP transaction when a message is refused
- Do not crash when reindexing an empty database
- Return an error when parsing a message for the envelope cache panics
- Give the readyz probe a time limit

### Chore
- Resolve the `latest` message ID in a single helper
- Update Go dependencies
- Update node dependencies

### Fix
- Parse address headers with non-UTF-8 display names ([#763](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/763))
- Append missing recipients to an existing Bcc header
- Keep address parsing strict when decoding non-UTF-8 display names
- Guard against an empty `Sender` address list when releasing a message
- Reject messages that cannot be parsed instead of discarding them silently ([#764](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/764))
- Return 400 for an invalid `DELETE /api/v1/messages` body ([#766](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/766))
- Decode RFC 2231 attachment file names in non-UTF-8 charsets ([#767](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/767))
- Accept `latest` as the ID in the release and thumbnail endpoints ([#768](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/768))
- Limit the number & total size of remote stylesheets fetched by HTML check (Kiseob Hong @Minerv4)

### Test
- Enhance thumbnail tests for `latest` ID handling and add empty case

### Feature
- Add optional Subject prefix for SMTP [relay](https://mailpit.axllent.org/docs/configuration/smtp-relay/#subject-prefix) & [forward](https://mailpit.axllent.org/docs/configuration/smtp-forward/#subject-prefix) ([#755](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/755))
- Add optional [Rspamd integration](https://mailpit.axllent.org/docs/configuration/rspamd/) for spam checking

### Chore
- Implement dynamic check tabs for HTML, Link, and Spam checks in message view
- Update Go dependencies
- Update node dependencies
- Update Github Actions dependencies

### Fix
- Limit envelope cache to messages with images and bound its memory ([#754](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/754))
- Negated size and date searches miss or duplicate boundary messages ([#757](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/757))
- Detect a link at the very start of a text/plain body in link check ([#759](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/759))
- Detect a link at the very start of a text/plain body in Mailpit UI
- Allow downloads from links in the HTML message preview ([#760](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/760))

## This release includes security fixes, so upgrading is strongly recommended.
A maliciously crafted image attached to an email could make the thumbnail generator (used by the web UI and API) spin in an infinite loop. The exif reader has been replaced with a minimal in-tree EXIF orientation reader that only reads the first block and never follows pointers.

This release also strips `<base>` and meta refresh tags from `/view/{ID}.html` output, and limits concurrent HTTP, SMTP and POP3 connections to 1000 each.

Due to timing, these security fixes have released together with new UI features in this release.

### Security
- Replace goexif with minimal EXIF orientation reader ([GHSA-379p-g4f4-hq5h](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/security/advisories/GHSA-379p-g4f4-hq5h))
- Strip base and meta refresh tags from /view/{ID}.html output
- Limit concurrent SMTP, POP3 and HTTP connections to 1000 each

### Feature
- Autocomplete search suggestions and history ([#745](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/745))
- Open received email when clicking a browser notification ([#747](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/747))

### Chore
- Add composite index on message_tags (ID, TagID) to keep inserts fast as the mailbox grows ([#750](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/750))
- Reject EXIF IFD0 offsets that overlap the TIFF header
- Update Go dependencies
- Update node dependencies

### Fix
- Resolve data races in mailbox stats broadcast, logger init and SMTP MaxRecipients

### Test
- Add JS tests for search suggestions and HTML sanitising
- Add e2e Playwright UI testing
- Add maximal APP1 and fill-byte cases for EXIF orientation reader

### Fix
- Remove expired envelope cache entries and clear them on auto-prune ([#748](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/748))

### Chore
- Add gosec #nosec annotations and set explicit Content-Type on error responses
- Update Go dependencies
- Update node dependencies

### Fix
- Escape `_` and `%` in search terms so they match literally ([#742](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/742))
- Match `&` and `\` in address searches ([#743](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/743))
- Validate AUTH parameter in MAIL FROM command ([#744](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/744))
- MAIL FROM parameters must be space-separated per RFC 5321

### Test
- Include additional tests for MAIL FROM parameters

### Fix
- Prevent duplicate messages from being added in websocket handlers ([#737](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/737))
- Set hostname for HELO/EHLO in SMTP client creation ([#738](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/738))

### Chore
- Update Go dependencies
- Update node dependencies
- Update GitHub Actions dependencies

### Chore
- Limit maximum MIME parts parsed per message to 500
- Refactor regex usage for string cleaning and normalization
- Optimize envelope parsing by using a shared parser instance
- Optimize message summary construction by eliminating JSON round-trip
- Replace bytes.ToLower with containsFold for case-insensitive tag matching
- Replace inline regex for leading whitespace with a package-level variable
- Symlink sendmail to Mailpit in Docker image ([#736](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/736))
- Update Go dependencies
- Update node dependencies
- Update GitHub Actions dependencies

## This release includes a security fix, so upgrading is strongly recommended.

A vulnerability was fixed which allowed animated image attachments (APNG, GIF, WebP) to bypass the thumbnail pixel budget, potentially causing multi-gigabyte memory allocation when the thumbnail was rendered.

Many thanks to the security researcher who responsibly disclosed this issue and helped improve Mailpit's security.

### Security
- Bound thumbnail decode to single frame ([GHSA-2vgv-6hcp-mf43](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/security/advisories/GHSA-2vgv-6hcp-mf43))

### Feature
- Add major version tag for Docker images in workflow ([#734](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/734))

### Chore
- Improve message rendering performance with envelope caching
- Update Go dependencies
- Update node dependencies
- Update caniemail test database

### Fix
- Re-quote local-parts in API JSON responses ([#732](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/732))

This release adds an optional feature to mitigate DNS rebinding attacks ([read more](https://mailpit.axllent.org/docs/configuration/http/#dns-rebinding-mitigation)), as well as other hardening fixes.

### Security
- Add `--allowed-hosts` flag to mitigate DNS rebinding against the API

### Chore
- Update Go dependencies
- Update node dependencies
- Update Github Actions

### Fix
- Block Azure WireServer, IPv4-translated prefix and additional reserved ranges in SSRF deny-list
- Pass line-boundary state to drainData to prevent SMTP desync
- Allow SP inside quoted local-parts per RFC 5321 ([#731](https://github.com/axllent/mailpit/issues/731))
- Bound header-rewrite scanner to header block and fail closed on missing header
- Prevent quadratic CPU in proxy CSS rewriter via O(1) asset dedup
